# Resource packs, Force Unicode Font and resource reloads while the demo song plays (fix/packs154). 1280x720, GUI
# scale 2 as the test world starts. Run it for 1.21.11 and 26.3:
#   gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref fix/packs154 -f version=1.21.11 -f script=.github/checks/packs.txt
#   gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref fix/packs154 -f version=26.3 -f script=.github/checks/packs.txt
# Every group shows the same things, so a shot can be laid beside the same shot of group 0:
#   -sky       the night sky lyrics (Lines layout), the top bar with the line being sung, and the Record card in the
#              bottom right with its three lyric lines
#   -settings  the settings screen, Lyrics tab; -about the About tab (wrapped paragraphs); -library the library screen;
#   -intro     the welcome screen (the only one with the game's own buttons on it)
# 0. Default packs: how everything should look.
# 1. Force Unicode Font on (no reload; the game's letters change in place): the game's letters in the settings, library
#    and welcome screens are the thinner Unicode ones; every label, button and value still fits its row with nothing
#    overlapping and "…" only where group 0 has one (Unicode letters are narrower, so maybe fewer). The smooth lyrics,
#    top bar and card text are the mod's own fonts and look the same as group 0.
# 2. High Contrast on (a reload): the mod's panels, rows and switches look exactly as in group 0 (they are drawn in the
#    mod's own colours); only the welcome screen's buttons are the black ones with white edges, their words readable.
#    The sky, bar and card as in group 0 (no black or missing boxes, no white squares where the cover or corners are).
# 3. Programmer Art on (a reload): the blocks look like old Minecraft; the lyrics, bar, card and settings as in group 0.
# 4. Reloads (F3 + T) mid-song, each one after the loading screen is gone:
#    -lines-after  the same line as -lines-before, its letters evenly spaced (none on top of each other, no gaps inside
#                  words), the sung part lit up to the right letter, the bar and card text in place with their rounded
#                  corners; no black or missing-letter boxes anywhere
#    -world-after  the World layout's floating words, letters whole and evenly spaced
#    -arc-after    the Arc layout, as above
#    -settings-after / -library-after  a reload with the screen open: the screen as in group 0, every row in place
#    -unicode-after  Force Unicode Font on and then a reload: as group 1, nothing left with the default letters' widths

cmd weather clear
cmd time set midnight
cmd gamerule doDaylightCycle false
cmd gamerule advance_time false
set barLyrics true
set hudOnlyOnChange false
set recordCard true
set cardLyrics true
set cardLines 3
set cardCorner BOTTOM_RIGHT
set layout LINES
look 0 -22
sleep 6

# 0. Default packs
seek 20
sleep 3
where
shot packs-0-sky
gui 0
sleep 3
shot packs-0-settings
gui 4
sleep 3
shot packs-0-about
close
screen dev.beli.skylyrics.gui.LibraryScreen
sleep 4
shot packs-0-library
close
screen dev.beli.skylyrics.gui.IntroScreen
sleep 3
shot packs-0-intro
close
sleep 1

# 1. Force Unicode Font
unicode on
seek 20
sleep 3
where
shot packs-1-sky
gui 0
sleep 3
shot packs-1-settings
gui 4
sleep 3
shot packs-1-about
close
screen dev.beli.skylyrics.gui.LibraryScreen
sleep 4
shot packs-1-library
close
screen dev.beli.skylyrics.gui.IntroScreen
sleep 3
shot packs-1-intro
close
unicode off
sleep 1

# 2. High Contrast
pack high_contrast on
wait resources reloaded
seek 20
sleep 3
where
shot packs-2-sky
gui 0
sleep 3
shot packs-2-settings
gui 4
sleep 3
shot packs-2-about
close
screen dev.beli.skylyrics.gui.LibraryScreen
sleep 4
shot packs-2-library
close
screen dev.beli.skylyrics.gui.IntroScreen
sleep 3
shot packs-2-intro
close
pack high_contrast off
wait resources reloaded

# 3. Programmer Art
pack programmer_art on
wait resources reloaded
seek 20
sleep 3
where
shot packs-3-sky
gui 0
sleep 3
shot packs-3-settings
close
pack programmer_art off
wait resources reloaded

# 4. Reloads mid-song
seek 20
sleep 2
where
shot packs-4-lines-before
reload
wait resources reloaded
sleep 1
where
shot packs-4-lines-after
set layout WORLD
seek 20
sleep 3
reload
wait resources reloaded
sleep 1
where
shot packs-4-world-after
set layout ARC
seek 20
sleep 3
reload
wait resources reloaded
sleep 1
where
shot packs-4-arc-after
set layout LINES
gui 4
sleep 3
reload
wait resources reloaded
sleep 2
shot packs-4-settings-after
close
screen dev.beli.skylyrics.gui.LibraryScreen
sleep 4
reload
wait resources reloaded
sleep 2
shot packs-4-library-after
close
unicode on
reload
wait resources reloaded
seek 20
sleep 3
where
shot packs-4-unicode-after
gui 0
sleep 3
shot packs-4-unicode-settings-after
close
unicode off

# Back as the test world starts
set recordCard false
set hudOnlyOnChange true
look 0 -28
sleep 2
